title: Steam Dial - An alternative steam library UI based on how much time you have to spend
author: deepbluefrogmods
selftext:
I hope this is a good place to post this, but since it was largely developed with the help of GitHub CoPilot and relevant to games, I thought I would share it here.

I created a small application called Steam Dial (packaged .exe for windows or local python web service for anything else). I got tired of waiting for Valve to add 'expected play time' to games filters in the Steam client. Since I have a day job and a very small window of play time, I always wondered how many of my unplayed games I could tackle without having to research every single one of them online.

This app plugs into the Steam Grid DB and Steam Web APIs if you have them but can work without as well. It allows you to view which games you can hope to cover within a set amount of time, including games you started and never finished. 

I can share the link to the source code if this is something of interest to anyone. I have been testing it and improving it for a while, and it has helped me already.
